output.one_liner: SEO API providing SEO and AEO data at scale for automating SEO workflows.

auth.notes: Static API key sent via Authorization header (Token or Bearer prefix) or query parameter. OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for MCP server.

evidence.snippet: Alternatively, you can pass the key as a URL query parameter named apikey.
Our MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address: https://api.seranking.com/mcp

access.notes: 14-day free trial with 100K API credits, no credit card required. Continued use requires paid plan or pay-as-you-go subscription.

evidence.snippet: The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access. No credit card required.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Data API 10 RPS, Project API 5 RPS, Trial 1 RPS. Standard and custom rate limits documented. Rolling-second enforcement at API key level.

evidence.snippet: One API for keywords, backlinks, domains, audits, AI search, and more.
Data API: 10 requests per second (RPS), Project API: 5 requests per second (RPS)
Trial accounts: During the trial period, the Data API has a default rate limit of 1 request per second (RPS)
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking and SE Visible data simply and securely.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve trial enables immediate API testing with well-documented REST endpoints, but trial expires after 14 days and production use requires paid subscription.

overview_evidence.snippet: SEO API: Automate your SEO workflows
